bullets: Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a meaningful part of Ironclad's procurement AI product area.
Develop a deep understanding of procurement and legal workflows, including intake, supplier and contract management, obligations, renewals, amendments, risk review, and…
Identify high-value opportunities where contract intelligence and AI can help procurement teams save time, prevent leakage, reduce risk, and gain leverage.
Shape experiences that connect structured contract data with actionable workflows—for example, supplier relationship views, contract-family intelligence, obligation tracking…
Partner with engineering, applied AI, data, and design to define the right product architecture, user experience, data requirements, and human approval points.
